theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fa_pj_gram_det_two_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (p q : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ T = 2 → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ T) => inner ℝ p (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i : Euclid P) * inner ℝ p (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j : Euclid P) + inner ℝ q (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i : Euclid P) * inner ℝ q (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j : Euclid P)) = ‖T.starProjection p‖ ^ 2 * ‖T.starProjection q‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (T.starProjection p) (T.starProjection q) ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
